title: 4 movies under 100 minutes that hit harder than a trilogy
caption: 4 movies under 100 minutes that hit harder than a trilogy. Save this before your next 3-hour slog.

scenes.voice: These four are under 100 minutes, and they hit harder than most trilogies.
12 Angry Men. 96 minutes. One room. No escape.
Before Sunset. 80 minutes. One walk. One clock.
Run Lola Run. 80 minutes. Three lives. Same street.
Locke. 85 minutes. One car. Tom Hardy talking to a dashboard, and it works.
Short is not small. It is a movie that cannot hide.

scenes.sub: Watch it again for the runtimes.
scenes.voice: Save this. Pick one tonight. Watch it again for the runtimes.
